company.description: Pectiv is a revolutionary Nanotechnology sanitary pads on monthly subscription service satisfy women’s need and solve their problems. Pectiv is a femtech and personal care brand specializing in premium feminine hygiene products, particularly sanitary pads designed with advanced anion and nanotechnology. The company focuses on providing hypoallergenic, high-absorption period care products that help reduce irritation, odor, and discomfort while improving comfort and hygiene for women.
